meta.title: KNOWLEDGE X — System Architecture
meta.subtitle: AI-Powered Multi-Document Research Knowledge Assistant · 7-Layer Architecture

components.label: Dashboard UI
components.explanation: pages/dashboard.py: Multi-PDF upload, public URL PDF import, live webcam scan, and full AI synthesis pipeline trigger.

components.label: Analysis & Gaps
components.explanation: pages/knowledge_analysis.py: Structured per-paper breakdowns, common cross-document concepts, glossary, and research gap detection.

components.label: Knowledge Map
components.explanation: pages/knowledge_map.py: Interactive Plotly + NetworkX visualization of papers, concepts, and research gaps.

components.label: Research Chat
components.explanation: pages/research_assistant.py: Citation-grounded question answering over uploaded PDF excerpts.

components.label: Ambiguity UI
components.explanation: pages/ambiguity_detector.py: Detects ambiguous queries, presents interpretations, and resolves answers.

components.label: History UI
components.explanation: pages/research_history.py: Browse, reload, and inspect past research analyses and ambiguity resolutions.

components.label: Login & Profile
components.explanation: app.py sidebar auth popover (Google OAuth + Email Sign In/Sign Up) and pages/profile.py.

components.label: Auth Service
components.explanation: modules/auth.py: Google OAuth 2.0 PKCE + OIDC ID token verification and scrypt local email/password auth.

components.label: Session & Scope
components.explanation: itsdangerous signed kx_auth_session cookie, SQLite auth_sessions, and per-user upload/history isolation.

components.label: App Controller
components.explanation: app.py: Initializes session state, SQLite schemas, auth lifecycle, sidebar controls, and st.navigation routing.

components.label: Analysis Engine
components.explanation: modules/ai_analysis.py + modules/research_gap.py: Structured Pydantic synthesis and gap detection.

components.label: Q&A & Ambiguity
components.explanation: modules/ai_analysis.py + modules/ambiguity_detector.py: Chunk retrieval, ambiguity classification, and rewriting.

components.label: History Manager
components.explanation: modules/history_db.py: Persists and scopes research_sessions and ambiguity_history per user.

components.label: PDF & URL Proc
components.explanation: modules/pdf_reader.py: PDF upload validation, SSRF-safe URL download, PyMuPDF text extraction, and chunking.

components.label: Scanner & OCR
components.explanation: modules/camera_component.py + modules/ocr_scanner.py: Persistent webcam capture, blur check, Gemini OCR, and PDF assembly.

components.label: Gemini API
components.explanation: Google Gemini API with structured JSON schemas, OCR vision extraction, and automatic model fallback.

components.label: Graph & Plotly
components.explanation: modules/knowledge_map.py: Builds concept-document-gap graph in NetworkX and renders interactive Plotly figures.

components.label: SQLite Database
components.explanation: knowledge_x_history.db: Stores research_sessions, ambiguity_history, users, auth_sessions, oauth_states, and app_settings.

components.label: User PDF Store
components.explanation: User-isolated filesystem storage for uploaded, URL-imported, and OCR-scanned PDFs.
